title: Mar Zutra Zuta
author: Aharon Hyman

paragraphs: Hyman quotes Yuchasin: “Mar Zutra Zuta expounded in the name of Mar Zutra Rabbah, and the Rabbis repeated it before Rav Papa.” In his entry on Mar Zutra Zuta, Heilprin writes, “I have not found it.” Hyman points out that the preceding entry, on Mar Zutra Rabbah, cites [Shabbat 50a](https://www.sefaria.org/Shabbat.50a.12) and [Beitzah 8a](https://www.sefaria.org/Beitzah.8a.7). He suggests that Yuchasin either had this wording or called the speaker “Zuta” because he taught in the name of Mar Zutra Rabbah. Hyman understands this to explain why Yuchasin gives no separate entry for Mar Zutra Rabbah. He considers Heilprin’s division needless.[^1]

notes.text: Both consulted Bavli passages call the speaker Mar Zutra and say he expounded in Mar Zutra Rabbah’s name. The two adjacent Seder HaDorot entries, [Mar Zutra Rabbah](https://www.girsology.com/seder-hadorot.html?entry=1095&lang=en) and [Mar Zutra Zuta](https://www.girsology.com/seder-hadorot.html?entry=1096&lang=en), show exactly how Heilprin divided the notices. The wording attributed to Yuchasin is Hyman’s quotation.
